Name: A Cleaner Valley - Remove Trash and Debris - Fix most Buildings
Author: krymzone1
Description:
You can find the full list of Changes here: https://pastebin.com/pMmV3MCK

v1.0.1:

-Added customization options, you can now turn on/off most maps added by the mod, it has simple functionality for now, mostly because most maps are not just edited but replaced as a whole, I know this is kind of a bad practice, but this way was not only a lot easier for me to do, but also a lot faster without me losing my sanity. I will most probably fix this issue later on
-Removed a few stones that I missed (Cindersap Forest)
-Fixed Fences on Backwoods and BusStop maps
-Patched holes in the docks on the beach farm
-Removed debris that I missed on Luau Map
-Made a version of the Riverland Farm with simpler bridges ( that looks better in my opinion, you can always turn it off )
-Modified most farms to remove that ugly path from the east entrance to the shipping bin + fixed fences
-Replaced the ravine next to the quarry with a river ( you can disable it in the config if you don't enjoy it )
-Fixed Pierre's Shop
-Removed an annoying stone near the BathHouse
-Fixed flooring in the train station
-Fixed Krobus's Room if you decide to have him as a spouse
-Fixed Witch's Hut Floorng
-Removed a floating stump that i forgot to remove on the Fair map
-Removed more debris that i forgot on the Halloween map
-Fixed a small bug in the Joja community center
-A lot more edits that i forgot to write down because I'm a dumbass

I did remove some stumps from the game, but I don't know if I should remove all of them (For example the ones from Cindersap Forest) or leave some be, for now I left some there, but I want to also know you opinion on it, here's a pool where you guys could vote on what I should do!  

https://strawpoll.com/polls/ajnEO62M9ZW

I also created a poll where you can leave your suggestions:

https://strawpoll.com/polls/wAg3A8NbKy8

You could also leave them in the mod's post page!

Things that I want to include in future versions:
-Fix building exteriors, for now you can use other mods for that, I think there are a few, but I want to also make my own version that's as close as possible to the vanilla buildings
-Fix some more interiors like the Captain's Room on Ginger Island ( In the far future I might add a way to fix the ship and even make it usable )
-Do something with the Pirate Cave ( don't know yet what )
-Clean the Mermaid House ( the one with the show during the Night Market )
-Will try to update and include the defunct "Summit Reborn" if I get the permission from EmissaryOfInfinity (Update: I tried contacting him but I got no response, I am at a dead end, I might try adding it on the account that the mod itself is abandoned, but If I am contacted by him at any point regarding the use of his content I will be forced to remove it whether I want it or not )
-Will probably modify the graveyard in town to make it a bit better-looking

[b]NOTE:[/b] The mod is in a VERY early stage, and given the nature and size of this mod bugs are bound to appear, please report any bugs/oversights that you find!

Known bugs:
-For some odd reason even though the debris is not there anymore there is still a small invisible barrier on the north-western side of the beach ( not much of a problem considering that part isn't that important anyway, still, I'll look for a way to fix it)
-Sometimes one of the windows on Robin's house flickers, I think I managed to fix it for me since I can't replicate it anymore, but I'm not sure it's 100% fixed
